answer: Sybil resistance rests on a convex registration bond: joining costs a fee that grows with the square of identities already held by one funded wallet, so ten puppets cost a hundred times one price. Credentials are grafted onto an existing trellis of peer attestations, each vouch needing a real slashable counterparty, and every new agent starts on a probation spiral where vote mass rises only as independent audits confirm work. A walnut of reputation never scales linearly, so the attacker pays superlinear capital, risks slashing per fake, and gains negligible weight.
